# Ivory Agentic Repository AIvory is a set of machine learning and agentic AI tools for performing image analysis to detect illegal wildlife trade images. In particular, it contains a set of tools for detecting and classifying images of illegal ivory and distinguishing them from bone carving objects: - A U-Net image segmentation model designed to distinguish ivory objects from bone at pixel-level - A set of agentic AI tools designed to assist illegal wildlife image detection and classification.
## Example notebooks: - `examples/agentic_llm_workflows.ipynb`: An illustration of agentic AI applications to image segmentation tasks, e.g., detecting required objects in images to prepare for machine learning image segmentation or to provide LLM textual descriptions for a given object. - `examples/Ivory_training_with_ROC.py`: The main training script that reproduces the results presented in Mozzon et al. 2026. This includes the key training scripts along with the statistical analysis. - `examples/ivory_agentic_comparison.ipynb`: This script contains the main comparison between the U-net classification results and a corresponding agentic AI classification for the same test images. - `examples/ml_resnet34_inference.ipynb`: This demonstrates the U-net image segmentation model performance on unseen test images. ## Quick Start + API code setup: Note that the scripts that use LLMs/agentic AI require you to load Google/Anthropic/OpenAI API key to work. ```bash cd github_repo python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pip install -e . # In case you get an error message related to plum-disptch, also run the following: python -m pip install --force-reinstall --no-cache-dir plum-dispatch export GOOGLE_API_KEY="..." export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="..." ``` ## Example Results
